 table salt
1/2 cup (120 ml) water (or to desired consistency)

1. Put all ingredients in a food processor or blender and puree until
smooth, adding water to the desired consistency.
2. Get your spoon and dig in!
Yield: 4 servings
NUTRITION INFORMATION: 800 total calories; 200 calories per serving; 34 g carbohydrate;
6 g protein; 5 g fat
